description: This file provides extended firmware functions for managing FLASH memory operations on STM32F4 microcontrollers, including erase, programming, and option bytes configuration, with support for dual bank and protection features.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Performs mass erase or sector erase on FLASH memory, with polling for completion.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Performs mass erase or sector erase on FLASH memory, with interrupt enabled.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs option bytes such as write protection, read protection, user options, and BOR level.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBProgram
methods.description: Programs advanced option bytes like PCROP, dual bank boot, and protection for specific STM32F4 devices.

methods.name: FLASH_FlushCaches
methods.description: Flushes instruction and data caches to ensure data consistency after flash operations.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves advanced option byte configuration for specific features.
